meta.title: Fix cache headers on range requests
meta.body_summary: Add cache headers (X-Cache, etc.) to range request responses for both raw and data endpoints, update OpenAPI docs, and add test for 206 responses with cache headers.

perf_labels.notes: Small fix adding cache headers to range responses; no human review, merged by self without blocking.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 85 lines added across 4 files, this is a very small change. It fits a quick-fix performance PR and is consistent with the low-friction self-merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No human reviewer feedback; only bot comments (codecov, coderabbitai) that were non-blocking and did not address performance claims.
review_details.performance_claim: Adding cache headers to range responses ensures consistent caching behavior and may improve cache hit rates, reducing redundant data transfer.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The maintainer used the agent to produce a small, self-contained fix and merged it without requiring independent review. This illustrates that for low-risk, header-level HTTP fixes, agent output can be directly accepted when the maintainer trusts the change.

detection_detail.code_reading: The maintainer presumably reviewed the changes before merging, as the PR author is the same person and no separate review was requested.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: One test added for cache header presence; overall test suite has pre-existing fetch failure; no benchmark or profiling to verify cache improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions; the change only adds headers and a test.

core_change_summary.description: Added setDataHeaders() calls in raw and data handler functions to include X-Cache and other cache headers in range request responses. Updated OpenAPI docs and added a test verifying x-cache header for 206 responses.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: OpenAPI spec and test files are supporting changes; fs-cleanup-worker added a comment unrelated to cache headers.
change_trajectory: Single commit: added setDataHeaders() in handlers, updated OpenAPI, added test for cache headers, and added FIXME comment in cleanup worker.

review_signals.summary: Codecov reported that all modified lines are covered by tests and project coverage unchanged at 72.91%.
CoderabbitAI provided a walkthrough summarizing changes across four files, noted ESLint tool run failure, and suggested reviewers.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by djwhitt (OpenAI_Codex); codecov and coderabbitai commented within minutes.
Three force pushes and a final commit refined the changes.
Merged after ~39.7 hours with no human review comments.
